newsitem.title: USA: US heating oil stocks up 1.3 mln bbl last week - EIA.
newsitem.headline: US heating oil stocks up 1.3 mln bbl last week - EIA.

text.p: U.S. heating oil stocks rose 1.3 million barrels to 49.1 million barrels in the week ending Sept 20 from the previous week, although total distillate stocks fell 500,000 barrels to 11.8 million barrels, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.

East Coast heating oil inventories grew by 1 million barrels to 23.3 million barrels, making up 61 percent of the East Coast distillate stocks, which include diesel, compared with 57 percent the previous week, an EIA analyst said.
Nevertheless, East Coast heating oil stocks remained lean compared with a year ago, when they held 42 million barrels.
New England total distillate stocks rose 700,000 bbl to 7.1 million bbl barrels, posting their largest week-to-week gain since early July, EIA said.

Total East Coast distillate stocks were drawn down by 1 million barrels to 38 million barrels in the week ending Sept 20 from the previous week, with production running at 3.4 million barrels per day and imports at 100,000 bpd matching last year's levels, EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
